cohort: 82 pregnant patients with intrahepatic cholestasis of pregnancy at a tertiary care hospital in Peshawar, Pakistan
finding: Intrahepatic cholestasis of pregnancy is associated with significant perinatal morbidity, including meconium-stained liquor (19.51%), fetal distress (15.85%), and nursery/NICU admission (16.27%).
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery rate was 28.09%, with main indications being fetal distress, meconium-stained liquor, and preterm labor/PPROM.
gest_age: Mean gestational age at diagnosis was 33.46 weeks and at delivery was 37.6 weeks.
